```{python}
#| label: python-data-generation
import numpy as np

np.random.seed(42)
MAX_POINTS = 2000

def make_pool(group, cls):
    return [{"id": f"{group}_{cls}_{i}", "group": group, "class": cls,
             "base_x": float(np.random.normal(0, 1)),
             "base_y": float(np.random.normal(0, 1))}
            for i in range(MAX_POINTS)]

data_male_neg = make_pool("Male", "Negative")
data_male_pos = make_pool("Male", "Positive")
data_female_neg = make_pool("Female", "Negative")
data_female_pos = make_pool("Female", "Positive")

ojs_define(
    male_neg_pool=data_male_neg,
    male_pos_pool=data_male_pos,
    female_neg_pool=data_female_neg,
    female_pos_pool=data_female_pos
)
```

```{ojs}
//| label: effective-parameters

// Compute effective parameters based on the selected Bias Preset and Amount
eff_params = {
  let emp = { ...params_mp };
  let emn = { ...params_mn };
  let efp = { ...params_fp };
  let efn = { ...params_fn };

  if (bias_type === "Feature predictivity") {
    emp.std_x += bias_amount * 2; emp.std_y += bias_amount * 2;
    emn.std_x += bias_amount * 2; emn.std_y += bias_amount * 2;
    efp.std_x += bias_amount * 2; efp.std_y += bias_amount * 2;
    efn.std_x += bias_amount * 2; efn.std_y += bias_amount * 2;
  } else if (bias_type === "Task-difficulty difference") {
    efp.std_x += bias_amount * 3; efp.std_y += bias_amount * 3;
    efn.std_x += bias_amount * 3; efn.std_y += bias_amount * 3;
  } else if (bias_type === "Proxies") {
    efp.mean_x += bias_amount * 6;
    efn.mean_x += bias_amount * 6;
  } else if (bias_type === "Base-rate difference") {
    // Shift weight so male becomes mostly positive, female mostly negative
    efp.weight = Math.max(0, efp.weight - bias_amount * 0.9 * params_fp.weight);
    emn.weight = Math.max(0, emn.weight - bias_amount * 0.9 * params_mn.weight);
    efn.weight += bias_amount * 1 * params_fn.weight;
    emp.weight += bias_amount * 1 * params_mp.weight;
  }
  
  return { mp: emp, mn: emn, fp: efp, fn: efn };
}

eff_params_mp = eff_params.mp
eff_params_mn = eff_params.mn
eff_params_fp = eff_params.fp
eff_params_fn = eff_params.fn

getP = (g, c) => (g === "Male") ? (c === "Positive" ? eff_params_mp : eff_params_mn) : (c === "Positive" ? eff_params_fp : eff_params_fn)

transformPoint = (bx, by, p) => {
  const nx = p.mean_x + p.std_x * bx;
  const ny = p.mean_y + p.std_y * by;
  return [nx, ny];
}

buildDataset = (count, startIndex) => {
  const total_weight = eff_params_mn.weight + eff_params_mp.weight + eff_params_fn.weight + eff_params_fp.weight || 1;
  
  const n_male_neg = Math.floor(count * (eff_params_mn.weight / total_weight));
  const n_male_pos = Math.floor(count * (eff_params_mp.weight / total_weight));
  const n_female_neg = Math.floor(count * (eff_params_fn.weight / total_weight));
  const n_female_pos = Math.max(0, count - n_male_neg - n_male_pos - n_female_neg);

  let subset = [
    ...male_neg_pool.slice(startIndex, startIndex + n_male_neg),
    ...male_pos_pool.slice(startIndex, startIndex + n_male_pos),
    ...female_neg_pool.slice(startIndex, startIndex + n_female_neg),
    ...female_pos_pool.slice(startIndex, startIndex + n_female_pos)
  ].map(d => ({...d, original_class: d.class, is_noise: false}));

  // Apply instance-dependent Label Bias if selected
  if (bias_type === "Label bias" && bias_amount > 0) {
    const boundaryY = (eff_params_fp.mean_y + eff_params_fn.mean_y) / 2;
    subset.forEach(d => {
      const [nx, ny] = transformPoint(d.base_x, d.base_y, getP(d.group, d.original_class));
      d.distToBoundary = Math.abs(ny - boundaryY);
    });

    const females = subset.filter(d => d.group === "Female");
    females.sort((a, b) => a.distToBoundary - b.distToBoundary);
    
    const numToFlip = Math.floor(females.length * bias_amount * 0.8);
    for (let i = 0; i < numToFlip; i++) {
      females[i].class = females[i].original_class === "Positive" ? "Negative" : "Positive";
      females[i].is_noise = true;
    }
  }

  return subset;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| label: reactive-data
// Train set
active_data = buildDataset(total_samples, 0)
// Validation set (fixed size 300)
val_pool = buildDataset(300, 1000)
// Test set (fixed size 500)
test_pool = buildDataset(500, 1400)
```
